title: Empty inbox illustration — round 1

payload.notes: Round 1 of the **empty inbox** illustration for Tern: four directions. It sits 320 px wide above *You're all caught up*, in both themes. Box or pin anything to fix: those regions go straight to the inpainting pass.

subject.name: Tern empty-inbox illustration
subject.use: 320 px wide above "You're all caught up", light and dark

images.name: Paper plane
images.reasoning: Mail as something that **flies off and is done**. The loop says *it went somewhere*, the sun keeps the empty state cheerful rather than bare.
images.prompt: Flat vector spot illustration, a paper plane looping over soft rolling hills, dotted trail, low sun, two clouds, cream background, navy line work, teal and sand palette, no text
images.alt: A paper plane loops over teal hills under a yellow sun, trailing a dotted line.

images.name: Mailbox garden
images.reasoning: An empty mailbox that has turned into a planter: nothing waiting, and that is fine. The bird gives it a face.
images.prompt: Flat vector spot illustration, a coral mailbox on a wooden post with flowers growing out of it, a small navy bird on the roof, flag up, soft mint circle behind, cream background
images.alt: A coral mailbox on a post, flowers growing beside it and a navy bird on its roof.

images.name: Hammock
images.reasoning: The inbox is resting. A night scene, so it stands out from the other three; check it in the light theme.
images.prompt: Flat vector spot illustration, a sleeping envelope in a coral hammock between two palm trees at night, crescent moon, stars, floating z letters, navy sky
images.alt: An envelope with closed eyes sleeps in a hammock between two palms under a crescent moon.

images.name: Tern
images.reasoning: The brand's own bird carrying the last letter away. Drawn as SVG, so it stays sharp at any size and is the cheapest to edit.
images.alt: A white tern glides over layered waves with a letter in its beak.

decisions.note: The direction. Keep the palette exactly as it is.

regions.note: Remove this cloud: it is cut off by the edge
A stray piece of the trail under the loop; remove it
Tilt the nose up a little, towards the sun

decisions.note: The fallback. The bird is lovely.

regions.note: The post floats; it should reach the grass

decisions.note: Too dark for the light theme, and a sleeping inbox reads as broken.

agent_note: Take the plane forward; fix the three regions first.
